commands.name: document-links
commands.command:
python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path
import re
paths=[Path(p) for p in ['"'"'docs/ubiquitous-language.md'"'"','"'"'docs/domain-model.md'"'"','"'"'docs/context-map.md'"'"','"'"'docs/adr/0006-context-boundaries.md'"'"','"'"'docs/adr/0007-actor-role-function.md'"'"','"'"'docs/adr/0008-decision-provenance.md'"'"','"'"'docs/adr/README.md'"'"','"'"'research/experiments/AE-002/tabletop.md'"'"','"'"'research/experiments/AE-002/review.md'"'"']]
checked=0
for p in paths:
    for link in re.findall(r'"'"'\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)'"'"',p.read_text()):
        if '"'"'://'"'"' in link: continue
        name,_,anchor=link.partition('"'"'#'"'"')
        dest=(p.parent/name) if name else p
        assert dest.is_file(), (str(p),link)
        if anchor and dest.suffix=='"'"'.md'"'"':
            headings=re.findall(r'"'"'^#+ (.+)$'"'"',dest.read_text(),re.M)
            slugs=[re.sub(r'"'"'[^\w\- ]'"'"','"'"''"'"',h.lower()).replace('"'"' '"'"','"'"'-'"'"') for h in headings]
            assert anchor in slugs,(str(p),link,slugs)
        checked+=1
print(f'"'"'PASS: {checked} relative document links and target anchors checked; historical snapshot excluded'"'"')
'
commands.stdout: PASS: 27 relative document links and target anchors checked; historical snapshot excluded

commands.name: predecessor-preservation
commands.command:
python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
base=Path('"'"'research/experiments/AE-002'"'"')
entry=json.loads((base/'"'"'entry-checks.json'"'"').read_text())
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
changed=[p for p,h in entry['"'"'predecessor_hashes_at_entry'"'"'].items() if sha(p)!=h]
assert changed==['"'"'docs/adr/README.md'"'"'],changed
assert sha(base/'"'"'predecessor-adr-register.md'"'"')==entry['"'"'predecessor_hashes_at_entry'"'"']['"'"'docs/adr/README.md'"'"']
print('"'"'PASS: only the required ADR register changed; archived bytes match the predecessor receipt'"'"')
'

commands.name: allowed-paths
commands.command:
python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess
queue=next(q for q in json.loads(Path('"'"'docs/campaigns/mvp/campaign.json'"'"').read_text())['"'"'queues'"'"'] if q['"'"'id'"'"']=='"'"'AE-002'"'"')
paths=subprocess.check_output(['"'"'git'"'"','"'"'diff'"'"','"'"'--cached'"'"','"'"'--name-only'"'"'],text=True).splitlines()
for p in paths:
    assert any(p==a or p.startswith(a.rstrip('"'"'/'"'"')+'"'"'/'"'"') for a in queue['"'"'allowed_paths'"'"']),p
assert paths
print(f'"'"'PASS: all {len(paths)} staged paths are within AE-002 scope'"'"')
'
